scope: Project-defined astrogeo error messages. Framework-generated argparse/HTTP server text is not included.
format_note: Strict JSON does not allow comments, so each message entry starts with a comment field describing the error type.

errors.comment: Input validation error: missing or blank city/place query.
errors.message: City must be a non-empty string.

errors.comment: Input validation error: invalid astrogeo API or main CLI date.
errors.message_template: Invalid date '{date}'. Expected YYYY-MM-DD with year 0001-9999.

placeholders.date: Submitted date string, or an empty string when omitted.

errors.comment: Input validation error: invalid astrogeo API or main CLI time.
errors.message_template: Invalid time '{time}'. Expected HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

placeholders.time: Submitted time string, or an empty string when omitted.

errors.comment: Geocoding error: city could not be resolved and the geocoder suggested adding regional context.
errors.message_template: Could not resolve city '{city}'. Try adding country/region.

errors.comment: Geocoding error: city could not be resolved without an additional lower-level explanation.
Geocoding error: lower-level geocoder/network failure passed through by the pipeline.

placeholders.exception: Exception text from the underlying network/API call.

errors.comment: Geocoding error: geocoder returned data in an unexpected shape.
Timezone lookup error: coordinates were found, but no IANA timezone could be resolved.
errors.message: Timezone could not be resolved from coordinates.

errors.comment: Astronomy computation error: constellation or solar context calculation failed.
Unexpected API/runtime error from the ASGI handler or standalone HTTP wrapper.
Routing error from the ASGI app when the request path is not the astrogeo route.
Routing error from the standalone HTTP wrapper when the request path is unknown.
HTTP method error from the ASGI app when a known route is called with a non-GET method.
Request parsing error from the standalone HTTP wrapper when POST body parsing fails.
Backend process error from the standalone HTTP wrapper when the CLI exceeds the timeout.

placeholders.timeout_seconds: Configured backend subprocess timeout in seconds.

errors.comment: Internal runtime error raised when the ASGI app receives a non-HTTP scope.
Civil-time validation error: invalid ambiguous-time policy.
Civil-time validation error: invalid nonexistent-time policy.
Civil-time validation error: non-positive search step for resolving DST gaps.
Civil-time validation error: non-positive search window for resolving DST gaps.
Civil-time resolution error: local wall time maps to two UTC instants.
errors.message_template: Ambiguous local time {local_datetime} in {tzname}; use ambiguous='earliest' or 'latest'.

errors.comment: Civil-time resolution error: local wall time falls in a DST gap.
errors.message_template: Non-existent local time {local_datetime} in {tzname} (DST gap); use nonexistent='shift_forward' or 'shift_backward'.

errors.comment: Civil-time resolution error: configured DST-gap search could not find a valid local time.
errors.message_template: Could not resolve non-existent time {local_datetime} in {tzname} within {shift_search_limit} using step {shift_resolution}.

errors.comment: Civil-time helper CLI validation error: invalid date argument.
Civil-time helper CLI validation error: invalid time argument.
errors.message_template: Invalid time '{time}'. Use HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

errors.comment: Geocoder library error: empty query passed directly to the geocoder.
Geocoder library error: no geocoder results for a direct geocoder query.
errors.message_template: No results for '{query}'. Try adding country/region.

errors.comment: Geocoder helper CLI error: input file could not be read.

placeholders.exception: Exception text raised while reading the input file.

errors.comment: Geocoder helper CLI usage error: neither a query nor an input file was provided.
